title: Harvington Youth Project: weekly groups are back
body: New-term groups meet at Harvington Baptist Chapel, £1 entry with a tuck shop: Adventurers (ages 7–10) on Thursdays 6.30–7.45pm, Explorers (10–13) on Tuesdays 6.30–8pm, and Ignite (13+) on Mondays 7–8.30pm. New volunteers are always welcome.
